subcategory_text: Policies, processes, and procedures for communicating progress on managing privacy risks are established and in place.
informative_references: GDPR Art. 33-34 (Breach notification), Recital 39 (Transparency on risk and safeguards)
implementation_examples: Establish policies and processes for communicating progress on managing privacy risks to internal and external stakeholders
Tailor communications to the audience (regulator, board, customers, employees) and align cadence with their expectations
Use trend and burndown views so that progress (or slippage) is visible over time
assessment_objectives: Determine whether communication processes exist for privacy-risk progress
Determine whether communications are tailored to stakeholder expectations
Determine whether progress is reported on a defined cadence
Determine whether communication artefacts are archived for accountability
